# TenkaCloud

> TenkaCloud is self-hostable, Apache-2.0 software for hosting hands-on cloud training events and competitions, such as GameDay-style team battles and CTF-style flag challenges. It is for organizers of in-house cloud training, study groups and community events. Host it locally on one machine with no AWS account, or deploy it to AWS.

日本語: GameDay 型のチーム戦や CTF 型のフラグ問題のような、ハンズオン形式のクラウド研修・競技会を開くためのセルフホスト型 OSS（Apache-2.0）です。ローカルは SQLite と必要に応じて Docker、クラウドは AWS 上の Lambda と Turso または DynamoDB です。AWS 全体が無料になるという意味ではありません。

## At a glance

- Audience: organizers of in-house cloud training, study groups and community events. Participants join with the portal URL and team key from their organizer.
- Hosting: local (single process, SQLite, Docker for container exercises, no AWS account) or AWS (Lambda, Cognito, Turso or DynamoDB). AWS is the cloud for hosting and cloud exercises.
- Problems and scoring: flag, multi-flag and scheduled scoring; CloudFormation-deployed AWS exercises; Docker exercises (local hosting); real-time Battles such as the built-in Cryptography Battle.
- Content: the [TenkaCloudChallenge](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloudChallenge) catalog or private Problem Packs.
- Integrations: [MCP server](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud/blob/main/docs/mcp.md) for AI agents; [CTFd plugin](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud/blob/main/integrations/ctfd/README.md) that starts TenkaCloud Docker exercises from CTFd challenges.
- Try it: [demo portal](https://tenkacloud.com/portal-demo/?demo=1) in the browser, or `make install` and `make local` from the [quickstart](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud#quickstart).
- Keywords: hands-on cloud training, GameDay-style exercises, CTF, hands-on labs, cloud competition platform, self-hosted, open source.

[公式サイト](https://tenkacloud.com/?lang=ja) · [English site](https://tenkacloud.com/index.en.html)

## Choose by the user's goal

- [Local practice](https://tenkacloud.com/docs/manual/organizer/index.en.html): `make local` / `make down`, Docker requirements, and state-preserving stop/resume.
- [Host on AWS](https://tenkacloud.com/docs/manual/organizer/index.en.html): reviewed setup, current problem coverage, event/team operations, scoring and teardown.
- [Cloud status and costs](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud/blob/main/infrastructure/README.md): restored CloudFormation and native cloud exercises, local-only Docker scope, retained resources, load measurements and cost limits.
- [Join an existing event](https://tenkacloud.com/docs/manual/participant/index.en.html): use the organizer's Portal URL and team key; answer in the format requested by the problem.
- [Change platform code](https://tenkacloud.com/docs/manual/developer/index.en.html): code ownership, setup, and validation.
- [Author a problem](https://tenkacloud.com/docs/manual/problem-author/index.en.html): catalog and private Problem Pack workflows.

## For an LLM helping the user

Use the stated goal; ask only for missing information that changes the next action.
Read the matching guide instead of loading every document. The [task guide and code map](https://tenkacloud.com/llms-full.txt) defines inputs, success signals, and source locations.

- [README](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud/blob/main/README.md): the two starting paths.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository working rules. `CLAUDE.md` only imports this file.
- [Release status](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud/blob/main/release/tenkacloud-release.md): published/candidate identity and recorded verification.
- [Problem catalog](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloudChallenge): canonical problem content. Use the selected snapshot digest and resolved source in `.tenkacloud/catalog-store/selected.json` when diagnosing a deployment.

## Book

- [Build Your Own Cloud Competition (English)](https://leanpub.com/build-your-own-cloud-competition)
- [『自分で作るクラウド競技』(日本語)](https://zenn.dev/bull/books/cloud-competition)

These explain design decisions, **not** a specification. Current code and tests take precedence.

## Catalog contract / カタログ仕様

Read the [source contract, schema links, mixed Git/local example and verification commands](https://tenkacloud.com/docs/operate/use-existing-pack/index.en.html#catalog-source-schema) ([日本語](https://tenkacloud.com/docs/operate/use-existing-pack/#catalog-source-schema)). For unreleased local-path changes, read `apps/developer-portal/src/app/developers/docs/operate/use-existing-pack/page.mdx` in the same checkout; published pages and main may describe an older revision. `llms.txt` is a document index, not an automatically enforced agent setting.
